definitions.common_cash_surplus: Operating cash flow minus cash purchases of PP&E, before finance lease principal.
definitions.cash_surplus_after_finance_lease_princip: Common cash surplus minus finance lease principal paid; not a claim to include every contractual obligation.
definitions.cash_and_debt_securities: Cash and equivalents plus debt-type marketable securities, excluding equity securities; not a guarantee every position is instantly available.
definitions.bond_carrying_value: Bond carrying value including current portion; not all lease liabilities or all next-twelve-month contractual cash obligations.
definitions.contingent_exposure: Record nominal/max exposure, recognized liability and actual payments separately; none is interchangeable.

Alphabet.credit_support_note: Data-center lease and energy-payment support; notional is not realized loss. Record trigger terms and actual payments separately.
notes: Do not describe all265.098bn cash plus securities as unrestricted cash-like liquidity.
